Basic chat completion via the GitHub Copilot provider (gpt-4o) with a single user message

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"github_copilot/gpt-4o\",\"temperature\":0}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.model())
debugPrint(result.usage()?.totalTokens() as Any)
```
